label: Keenable: Web Search
description: Search the web through Keenable and get results with their page text, ready for an LLM node. Works without a key; wire a KeenableAccess node for higher rate limits. Each text is cut at `maxTextChars`, and the longest ones shorter still when the results would weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Optional: a KeenableAccess node, for an API key's higher rate limits. Leave unwired to search without a key, rate limited per IP.

inputs.name: maxTextChars
inputs.label: Text per result
inputs.description: Max page-text characters per result. When the results would still weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries, the longest texts are cut shorter until they fit.

inputs.name: site
inputs.label: Site
inputs.description: Only results from this one domain. Empty = the whole web.

outputs.name: results
outputs.type: List[{ title: String | Null, url: String, text: String | Null }]
